title: Custom Jersey Creator (2026)
verdict: The custom jersey creator to use in 2026 is Wooter's builder. Choose your sport, pick one of 500+ styles, and change the colors, logo, team name and roster with a live preview and the price on screen.
Boombah's creator is strong for baseball, softball and basketball. Custom Ink's Design Lab creates printed jerseys. Champro's and Nike Team's creators produce a design that a dealer orders.

steps.name: Find the logo file
steps.text: A vector file is best. A large PNG will do.

steps.name: Write the roster
steps.text: Name, number and size for every player.

steps.name: Know your date
steps.text: Count back three weeks from the first game, plus time to approve.

steps.name: Enter the roster and order
steps.text: Check the proof before you approve.

ranking.fit: First-time organizers who want a creator that covers every sport and ends in a checkout.
ranking.lacks: The creator is instant. The jerseys arrive three weeks after approval.

ranking.fit: Teams comfortable in an online builder that want to buy from the factory.
ranking.lacks: Baseball and softball get its deepest range. Other sports have fewer styles.

ranking.fit: Groups that want a design printed on stock jerseys, with a group order form for sizes.
ranking.lacks: The garment is stock, so cut, panels and fabric are fixed.

ranking.fit: Coaches whose school or league already has a Champro dealer.
ranking.lacks: No public prices, and the dealer places the order.

ranking.fit: Programs that want the Nike mark and can order months ahead.
ranking.lacks: 30, 60 or 90 days for build-to-order, through a dealer.

why: If you have never ordered jerseys, the creator is the easy part. What slows first-timers down is not having three things ready: a logo file, a roster and a date.
Gather those first and Wooter's creator goes quickly. The roster step asks for each player's name, number, size and quantity.
Missing the logo? The design service is free, and a designer can build a wordmark from the team name.

criteria.name: Every sport
criteria.text: One creator for all your teams.

faq.q: What do I need before I start?
faq.a: Team colors, a logo if you have one, a roster with sizes and the date you need the jerseys.

faq.q: Which sports does the creator cover?
faq.a: Wooter lists basketball, football, flag football and 7v7, soccer, baseball, softball, volleyball, lacrosse, cheer, tennis and wrestling.
Yes. Wooter's builder and design service are free. You pay when you order.

faq.q: Can I create a jersey without a logo?
faq.a: Yes. Use the team name as the mark, or ask the designers to draw one.

faq.q: How long until the jerseys arrive?
faq.a: Plan on three weeks from the day you approve the proof. Wooter offers rush production if you are short on time.
